Priya M: quick review pls — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1427. small change: add kv_cache prefetch for multi-request batches and tighten attention-kernel selection sync. aiming for release cutoff today noon PST, so if anyone can give a quick look that would be awesome. TL;DR: prefetch only when batch_size>1, avoid double free on cancelled requests, and prefer kernel variant 'attn_v2' for seq>=512. tests added and bench numbers below.

Sam K: pinged. can you paste the bench command + the unit that covers the race? also any risk to Dedicated/Dedicated hot path? :eyes:

Priya M: bench cmd: `./tools/bench/throughput --model llama-13b --seq 512 --batch 8 --runs 50`
results: baseline ~17.8k tok/s -> 20.0k tok/s (about 12% throughput uplift for batching-heavy workloads). p50 latency dropped ~7ms on our regression harness. Unit: `tests/kv/test_prefetch.py::test_prefetch_race` + small fuzz loop in tests/kv/fuzz_prefetch.py. No changes to public API, config flag `enable_prefetch` defaults to false for Dedicated until we flip.

Max R: quick skim — I think there's a potential use-after-free in kv_cache/prefetch when a request cancels. snippet: 
```cpp
if (prefetch_future.valid())
  prefetch_future.then([&cache]{ cache->touch(); });
```
Should capture `shared_ptr<Cache>` in the lambda instead of referencing raw `cache` pointer. Also, the kernel selection path might call `select_kernel()` while state is being updated; a lightweight mutex there would be safer.

Priya M: nice catch, thanks. I'll switch to capturing a shared_ptr and add a small atomic/state check for kernel selection. will push a fix shortly.

Nina P: I'll take a look in ~1h after standup. if Sam or Max can give an early thumbs that'd speed this up.

Sam K: leaving inline comments now. one nit: prefer `if (max_batch_size > 1)` rather than `if (max_batch_size >= 2)` for clarity, and add a short comment about why we prefetch only for multi-request batches (reduce wasted work).

Priya M: updated per comments, added capture fix and a tiny mutex in select_kernel(), and expanded unit test to assert no dangling ptr on cancellation. PTAL.

ci-bot: Build succeeded — linux/gcc, macos, unit tests green. https://ci.redwood/1427/build/6789 :white_check_mark:

Max R: LGTM after the shared_ptr change + CI green. :thumbsup:

Priya M: squashed and pushed the final patch. bumping for final approval.

Nina P: read through — looks good from my side, approved. keeping the `enable_prefetch` opt-in for Dedicated is smart.

merge-bot: PR #1427 merged into main by merge-bot at 2025-07-05T19:15:00Z

Sam K: great, thanks — I'll watch the canary in infra tomorrow morning and flag any regressions.

Priya M: thanks everyone :rocket: Appreciate the speedy reviews!
